verdict.rationale: Foreloop's own Development → Agents view lists each running worker with the agent it runs as, its checkout name, the task it holds, and the last thing it said, and the task-executor skill has agents report back on their tasks. That gives a developer a per-agent status snapshot, but the docs never describe live, real-time observation of what the agent is doing. Missing for 10: documented real-time or live-updating activity view, an explicit agent status field (e.g. idle, working, blocked), a step-by-step activity log, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can watch what a running agent is doing in real time, including its current status

citations.quote: Development, under Agents, lists one row per worker: which agent it is running as, the name that checkout gave itself, the task it holds, and the last thing it said.
teaches an agent working there how to claim and report on Foreloop tasks
